Priya Narang: Quick note  compressed QBR for Crestline next Tue (15m). SVP Ops attending. Need a single-slide exec ask, current onboarding gates, renewal pulse, and clear owners. Deck: https://tiny.redwood/crestline-qbr

Alia Morgan: I'll pull 30/60 retention + activation funnel and drop charts on slide 3 by EOD.

Diego Ramos: Renewal pulse = amber. Key risks: analytics export not enabled, SSO claim mismatch, and low seat activation after demo. Recommend ask: pilot extension + one-off credits + priority analytics access.

Nina Shah: I can run a short 72-hour enablement sprint to re-run demo flows and capture playbook gaps. Request 6 SE-hours. Will prepare a 1-pager runbook.

Priya Narang: Please add a one-line "ask for exec" into slide 1 by EOD. Keep it action-oriented. Also need canonical renewal score and top-2 mitigations.

Owen Park: Invites sent. I'll make slide 2 "decision needed" and include a crisp line: pilot yes/no + allocation of enablement hours.

ops-bot: Reminder set: final deck review on 2026-01-08 16:00 PST.

Alia Morgan: Uploaded charts. Notable: 21% drop between day 7-14. Added assumptions in notes.

Diego Ramos: SSO ticket assigned to Crest infra, ETA Thu EOD. Analytics export on backlog; escalation created.

Priya Narang: Action items (copying here):
```
- Nina: enablement sprint plan + SE-hours request (due Fri EOD)
- Alia: data slides + brief appendix (due Mon noon)
- Diego: SSO + analytics status update (due Mon 5pm)
- Owen: exec slide + invite confirm (done)
- Priya: collect customer quote + finalize asks (due Tue morning)
```

Nina Shah: Will post runbook by Fri and prep a 2-slide appendix for the deck.

Alia Morgan: I'll be on the dry run.

Priya Narang: Dry run scheduled Mon 09:00 (12 min). Keep remarks tight (60-90s). If blockers surface, drop them here. :rocket:

Diego Ramos: Added my one-line ask in the doc: "Approve 4-week pilot extension + temporary analytics access and enablement credits."

Nina Shah: Acknowledged. I'll prep the enablement checklist for the dry run.

Owen Park: :thumbsup: Thanks team.
